caveat: fixture scale (2^25-point group), short walk window; meets_per_record is not comparable across arms because the arms visit different numbers of distinct points
reading: at identical curve, classes, DP mask (2^-4), 2000 walkers x 1000 steps: the guarded walk produces 3.75x MORE full-point meets per walker than the pre-guard walk, because the pre-guard walk collapses into the short cycle (11.4k distinct DP points over 2e6 walker-steps vs 98.7k). The guarded transition does not lose coalescence; applying the pre-guard fitted p to it is conservative.
